aliases: Sacred Eagle City Lord Uncle Eagle

summary.text: Eagle Warrior is a rank seven Combat Beast Warrior of Beast Calamity grotto-heaven who transforms with a silver-white giant eagle and later speaks as Sacred Eagle City Lord.

claims.text: When a huge monster appears outside a Beast Calamity city, a Combat Beast Warrior comes to the wall: a middle-aged man with rank seven Gu Immortal cultivation and a serious expression. He calls his combat beast and merges with a silver-white giant eagle that is an ancient desolate beast. The lights join and he takes an eagle-headed, winged warrior form as tall as the city wall. The crowd names him Eagle Warrior and cheers as he flies at Fang Yuan. Fang Yuan’s slap knocks him from the sky into a crater.

He is a middle-aged man with a plain look and a serious expression. In combat beast form he has an eagle head, a human body, and two wings, and stands as tall as the city wall. The silver-white giant eagle he merges with is an ancient desolate beast.

He rises from the crater, recovers his courage, and uses the combat technique Silver Illusion: his body turns illusory and splits into six lifelike images that circle Fang Yuan. Fang Yuan sees the diving attackers as empty illusions, then slows time around Eagle Warrior and wounds him. Eagle Warrior shouts that other beast warriors will still come, then Fang Yuan crushes his head; the headless corpse falls and raises dust.
In Star Snail Hall, Combat Beast Warriors say Eagle Warrior and Deer Warrior died miserably at the Bull-headed Demon God’s hands and call for revenge.

When young Gu Masters pull Combat Beast Warriors from the golden fog, one saved Eagle Warrior thanks the lad and offers help in Sacred Eagle City if needed. Narration notes that Fang Yuan killed this Eagle Warrior in the previous life, and that Fang Yuan’s clone saves him this time.

In Sacred Eagle City under a sudden beast calamity, Eagle Warrior is heavily injured by an immemorial desolate eagle yet still tries to rise for his people. Little Du calls him Uncle Eagle. Eagle Warrior names himself Sacred Eagle City Lord, refuses to watch the city become food for beasts, and asks Little Du to leave and later retrieve his corpse for burial in the garden. He turns into a heavily injured silver eagle and charges the immemorial desolate eagle again, falls into disadvantage, and is saved twice more by Little Du. After fainting he wakes below the City Lord Manor, explains the sealed altar of the first generation Combat Beast King, and later hails Little Du as the future Combat Beast King and world savior when the altar’s power enters the boy.
When Fang Yuan has placed Sacred Eagle City in Mini Western Desert, the Eagle Warrior in charge of the city flies out to greet Mo Tan Sang and says that from then on they will be in his care.
